facts.fact: Ahrefs' Lite plan is listed at $129 per month on the pricing page.
Ahrefs' Standard plan is listed at $249 per month on the pricing page.
Ahrefs' Advanced plan is listed at $449 per month on the pricing page.
Ahrefs states that paying annually saves up to 17% on its plans.
Ahrefs' Starter plan is listed at $29 per month on the pricing page.
Ahrefs' Brand Radar AI add-on starts from $199 per month.
The Lite plan includes 1 user, and additional users cost $40 per month each.
facts.unit: USD per month per additional user

facts.fact: The Standard plan includes 1 user, and additional users cost $60 per month each.
facts.unit: USD per month per additional user

facts.fact: The Advanced plan includes 1 user, and additional users cost $80 per month each.
facts.unit: USD per month per additional user

facts.fact: The Lite plan includes 750 tracked keywords.
The Standard plan includes 2,000 tracked keywords.
The Advanced plan includes 5,000 tracked keywords.
The Lite plan includes 150 checks on AI prompts.
The Standard plan includes 300 checks on AI prompts.
The Advanced plan includes 600 checks on AI prompts.
The Lite plan includes 100,000 crawl credits.
The Standard plan includes 500,000 crawl credits.
The Advanced plan includes 1,500,000 crawl credits.
The Lite plan includes 6 months of historical data.
The Standard plan includes 2 years of historical data.
The Advanced plan includes 5 years of historical data.
The Lite plan includes 5 non-verified projects and unlimited verified projects.
Ahrefs' Brand Radar AI draws on more than 551 million organic prompts from its database.
facts.quote: Research any brand across 551 million+ organic prompts from Ahrefs database

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that tracking one prompt on one platform in one location uses 1 check, and overage is billed at the end of the billing month.
facts.unit: check per prompt, platform, and location
facts.quote: Tracking one prompt on one platform in one location uses 1 check. Overage is billed at the end of the billing month.

facts.fact: Ahrefs describes its crawler as the world's second-most active, a vendor claim with 10+ years of web-scale data.
facts.quote: powered by the world’s second-most active crawler and 10+ years of web-scale data
